measurementNotes: Run serially, without other suites or load. Four warmups then fifteen recorded fresh Page executions per case in each of three processes per implementation. Each benchmark process uses the same case order.

Stage intervals are disjoint and contained by total Clear. Native Clear and Page/native-gap spans overlap and must not be added. HTTP Page elapsedMs uses the existing Date.now ledger; Clear and filesystem observations use performance.now.

Only execution/form-clear-edit.js differs among paired benchmark source hashes. The baseline helper calls edit.setProperty(id,name,value) and returns true; the final server-only helper elides already empty property candidates after live authority/JSON checks. Shared mutation code and client artifacts are unchanged.

HTTP before captures use the same instrumented Page/harness as after. Each window is a fresh SQLite Contact installation with a separate supervised client, concurrency twelve, no retries. The original Spike D sample remains historical, separate evidence.
